tool_architecture.primary_function: Automated CDC Noticeboard Scraper and Notification Forwarder
tool_architecture.description: The most critical asset within the MetaKGP repository. Functions as a relentless, automated scraper directed at the CDC noticeboard. Because the CDC releases highly time-sensitive notifications regarding company shortlists, OA links, and interview schedules, manual monitoring is highly inefficient. mftp containerizes scraping logic and polls CDC servers at extreme frequencies.

operational_mechanics.trigger_mechanism: Detects DOM changes or new database entries on the CDC noticeboard

sub_modules.name: mftp-doctor
sub_modules.function: Health-monitoring utility for the scraping engine. Alerts maintainers if the scraper crashes due to administrative countermeasures or server timeouts. Ensures continuous uptime during chaotic Phase 1 placement drives.

compliance_and_risk_warnings: Utilizing the tool on a wide scale without the consent of the Placement Committee violates institutional policies
Documented risks include disciplinary action ranging from temporary suspension to permanent blacklisting from the CDC process
Repository explicitly issues warnings regarding its use
Exists in a legally and ethically ambiguous domain
